in a dry pan, then blitz with chilli flakes, salt and garlic for the achar.Christine's wedding salmon and fig canapésChristine's wedding at the startHow to make itAs written, serves 4Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and fig and goat's cheese bites.Warm 16 cocktail blinis at 180°C for 4 minutes.Mix 120g crème fraîche with lemon zest and top each blini with a spoon of it, a fold of smoked salmon and a dill sprig.Quarter 4 fresh figs.Sit each quarter on a small crostini with a little soft goat's cheese from 120g, drizzle with honey and add cracked pepper.Arrange both on a platter.MainsMultiverse noodle bowlsBraised pork belly, miso broth, ramen noodles and soft boiled eggsHow to make it600g pork belly100ml soy sauce4 portions ramen noodles3 tbsp white miso1 L chicken stock4 eggs1 can corn kernels4 sheets of noriBraise the pork belly in soy and water until tender, then slice.Simmer the pork.Soft-boil the eggs, cool and halve.Heat the stock and whisk in the miso.Cook the noodles and build each bowl differently with pork, eggs, corn and nori.Westview spaghetti and meatballsWanda's dream of a family lifeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef meatballs browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, served over spaghetti with garlic bread and parmesan, family style.Mix 600g beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, 2 crushed garlic cloves, parsley and salt and roll into 20 meatballs.Brown in olive oil and set aside.Soften 1 diced onion in the same pan, add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, a pinch of sugar and basil and simmer 15
